question: Why can teacher not load Absences (Permission missing) in UntisX (endpoint /cloud)?
answer: Check role teacher. Module Absences may require higher permissions. Error Permission missing: on 401/403 check credentials and tab permissions, on 404 check the route in App.tsx/AppNavigation.kt, on 500 check server logs and database, on timeout check the Docker container and network. Validate endpoint /cloud and the database connection. Feature Absences must be enabled.
